newsitem.title: USA: Connex Intl expands into videoconferencing.
newsitem.headline: Connex Intl expands into videoconferencing.

text.p: Communications management company Connex International said Thursday it has added videoconferencing to its services, in a bid to gain more business from big corporate clients.
The company projects its revenues from videoconferencing to grow to $1.8 million in 1999, from $400,000 this year, Connex public relations coordinator Peter Eichbaum said.
"It will be a substantial part of our business," Eichbaum told Reuters.
He said clients will use the service for corporate meetings, financial earnings announcements and training programs.
Connex had specialized in audioconferencing for pharmaceutical, high-technology and financial services clients since its founding in 1982.
